mods.title: Kirovetz K4
mods.author: Cheb_mods, loopol_mods
mods.description: Kirovetz K4 is a general purpose agricultural tractor, four-wheel drive, articulated frame. Kirovetz K4 is a universal farm tractor, the most effective for farms with arable land from 500 hectares to 2000 hectares. K4 will also fit into the agricultural technology of large land users and agricultural holdings, primarily for solving the following tasks: frequent transportation of equipment to remote fields on public roads, work on small contour fields. Power: 240 HP (184 kW). Top speed: 45 kph. Price: 110000 $

mods.description:
John Deere 8R 2011 Series

285 to 410 engine hp. The 8R Series Tractors are world-class machines designed
to provide the hydraulic capacity and horsepower to handle large planters and implements.
Powered by the PowerTech™ PSS 9.0L engine, the 8R is a champion in the field, delivering
